ticket_key: Multi-month prepay totals on Order Summary

test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want an order that mixes a prepaid multi-month line with an ordinary line to show both the monthly total and the prepaid total on the Order Summary
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
A Metro by T-Mobile store rep activates phone lines for customers. Most customers pay one month of service up front and are then billed every month. Some promotions work differently: the customer pays three months of service in advance and gets the following three months free. A customer can have both kinds of line on the same order - for example one line taking the prepay promotion and a second ordinary line for a family member. Because the two kinds of money behave differently, the Order Summary now reports them on separate lines: a monthly total for the ordinary lines and a separate prepaid total for the lines paid in advance. This test checks that an order carrying both kinds of line reports both amounts, so the rep can explain to the customer what is being paid today and what will be billed monthly afterwards.

## Related tickets
RTPL-3118 (fixed, Verified), RTPL-2585 (cart pricing on promotion selection), RTPL-2454 (plan requires the coupon), RTPL-3207 (related open issue, not covered here)

## Preconditions
- Rep is logged into RT Go with the UAT2 environment selected (the multi-month plan and its promotion are offered there; on UAT3 the promotions list has been coming back empty).
- Customer credential capture on the tablet is switched off, so the rep completes the customer details on the store computer.
- Two customer-owned Android phones that have never been registered before, and two unused SIM cards.

## Test data
- **Line 1 phone (IMEI):** 350108845066494  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, walked live through this whole flow on the probe run; use the next unused row from the UAT2 BYOD sheet of the RTGO Data workbook for a fresh run)_
- **Line 1 SIM (ICCID):** 8901260000075822537F  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, accepted live; next unused candidates 8901260000075822528F, 8901260000075822519F, 8901260000075822500F)_
- **Line 2 phone (IMEI):** Next unused row from the UAT2 BYOD sheet of the RTGO Data workbook  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, sheet read live; two candidates (350108849311581 and 350108846256458) stopped on an empty Add BYOD device screen on this date - if that happens, move to the next row)_
- **Line 2 SIM (ICCID):** 8901260000075822528F  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, unused row from the UAT2 SIM sheet of the RTGO Data workbook)_
- **Line 1 plan:** 40L1WEB, shown as 6 Month Unlimited Plan at $40.00 per month  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the plan screen on the probe run)_
- **Line 1 promotion:** COUP_NEU3F3, shown as 6-Month Unlimited Plan with the badge 100% for 3 months and the tag Required  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the promotion screen on the probe run)_
- **Line 2 plan:** MAU55 at $60.00 per month  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the plan screen on the probe run)_
- **Service area zip code:** 33179  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, used live; the phone number list returned (786) 269-*, (305) 200-* and (305) 502-*)_

## Automation Notes
- If any pinned phone or SIM number is rejected when the team runs this (device already active, SIM already used, or the Add BYOD device page comes up empty), move to the next candidate row in the RTGO Data workbook. If the candidates run out or the data behaves differently from what is written here, contact the manual QA team to get working data - do not sit blocked and do not hunt for data alone.
- Reference figures from the live run on 2026-09-21 (UAT2): a single multi-month line on plan 40L1WEB showed Total MMP $120.00 - three months of the $40.00 monthly rate - with Edge due immediately $120.00. Use these to sanity-check the arithmetic; the exact amounts move with the plan and the store's SIM pricing.

test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want an order where every line takes the multi-month prepay promotion to show only the prepaid total, with each line's three months added up
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
A Metro by T-Mobile store rep activates phone lines for customers. When a customer takes the multi-month promotion, they pay three months of service in advance instead of one month, and get the following three months free. A customer can put more than one line on the same order and take the promotion on each of them - two family members each paying three months up front. The promotion is worked out for each line on its own; nothing is shared or pooled between the lines. When every line on the order has paid in advance, there is no ordinary monthly charge left to report, so the Order Summary shows only the prepaid total. This test checks both of those rules on a two-line order.

## Related tickets
RTPL-3118 (fixed, Verified), RTPL-2454 (plan requires the coupon)

## Preconditions
- Rep is logged into RT Go with the UAT2 environment selected.
- Customer credential capture on the tablet is switched off.
- Two customer-owned Android phones that have never been registered before, and two unused SIM cards.

## Test data
- **Line 1 phone (IMEI):** Next unused row from the UAT2 BYOD sheet of the RTGO Data workbook  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, sheet read live; 350108845066494 completed this flow on this date)_
- **Line 1 SIM (ICCID):** 8901260000075822519F  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, unused row from the UAT2 SIM sheet of the RTGO Data workbook)_
- **Line 2 phone (IMEI):** Next unused row from the UAT2 BYOD sheet of the RTGO Data workbook  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, sheet read live; two candidates (350108849311581 and 350108846256458) stopped on an empty Add BYOD device screen on this date - if that happens, move to the next row)_
- **Line 2 SIM (ICCID):** 8901260000075822500F  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, unused row from the UAT2 SIM sheet of the RTGO Data workbook)_
- **Plan for both lines:** 40L1WEB, shown as 6 Month Unlimited Plan at $40.00 per month  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the plan screen on the probe run)_
- **Promotion for both lines:** COUP_NEU3F3, shown as 6-Month Unlimited Plan with the badge 100% for 3 months and the tag Required  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the promotion screen on the probe run)_
- **Service area zip code:** 33179  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, used live; the phone number list returned (786) 269-*, (305) 200-* and (305) 502-*)_

## Automation Notes
- If any pinned phone or SIM number is rejected (device already active, SIM already used, or the Add BYOD device page comes up empty), move to the next candidate row in the RTGO Data workbook. test_cases.name: As a Metro by T-Mobile authorized dealer, I want a monthly add-on service bought on a prepaid multi-month line to be included in the amount paid in advance
test_cases.custom_requirements:
## What this test is about
A Metro by T-Mobile store rep can sell extra monthly services alongside a plan - for example an international calling package billed every month. When the customer takes the multi-month promotion, they pay their service three months in advance. Everything that is billed monthly on that line is part of what is paid in advance, so an add-on service bought on that line is charged for the same three months. Things bought once, such as the SIM card, are charged once and are not multiplied. This test checks that an add-on bought on a prepaid line lands inside the prepaid total instead of being billed as an ordinary month.

## Related tickets
RTPL-3118 (fixed, Verified), RTPL-2584 (promotion details behind the calculation)

## Preconditions
- Rep is logged into RT Go with the UAT2 environment selected.
- Customer credential capture on the tablet is switched off.
- One customer-owned Android phone that has never been registered before, and one unused SIM card.

## Test data
- **Phone (IMEI):** Next unused row from the UAT2 BYOD sheet of the RTGO Data workbook  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, sheet read live; 350108845066494 completed this flow on this date)_
- **SIM (ICCID):** 8901260000075822528F  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, unused row from the UAT2 SIM sheet of the RTGO Data workbook)_
- **Plan:** 40L1WEB, shown as 6 Month Unlimited Plan at $40.00 per month  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the plan screen on the probe run)_
- **Promotion:** COUP_NEU3F3, shown as 6-Month Unlimited Plan with the badge 100% for 3 months and the tag Required  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the promotion screen on the probe run)_
- **Add-on service:** ILD100P, shown as Global Voice 100 Plus at $20.00 per month on the International tab  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, read live from the Add on services page on the probe run)_
- **Service area zip code:** 33179  _(verified: UAT2 2026-09-21, used live; the phone number list returned (786) 269-*, (305) 200-* and (305) 502-*)_

## Automation Notes
- If the pinned phone or SIM number is rejected (device already active, SIM already used, or the Add BYOD device page comes up empty), move to the next candidate row in the RTGO Data workbook. If the candidates run out or the data behaves differently from what is written here, contact the manual QA team to get working data.
- Reference figures from the live run on 2026-09-21 (UAT2): the plan alone produced Total MMP $120.00 - three months of $40.00. Adding the $20.00 monthly add-on is expected to take it to $180.00. Confirm the figure on the first run.
- Protection was not offered on the customer-owned line during the 2026-09-21 probe run, so this case uses a monthly add-on rather than a protection plan. If protection offers do appear on a later build, the same rule applies to them and the case can be extended.
